example_sentences_in_bangla: সে বড়পেট, একা একা পুরো থালা খাবার শেষ করে ফেলে।
এই বাচ্চাটা বড়পেট, সারাদিন খেতে থাকে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is big-stomached; he finishes the entire plate of food by himself.
This child has a big stomach; he keeps eating all day.
note: Refers to someone with an insatiable appetite, common in Bengali household conversations.
